candidate.title: Group members reload/pagination uses live-edited group name, breaking after unsaved rename
reports: membership reload urls use the mutable group name, so unsaved name edits cause paging, addition, or removal reloads to target a nonexistent group

app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:25 — editing a group name before adding or removing members makes the successful mutation refresh an unsaved name, failing the reload or showing another group's members.

findmembers builds the members url from the two-way-bound, live-edited name field ('/groups/' + this.get('name') + '/members.json'), so after an unsaved rename every pagination click and post-add/remove reload requests members for a non-existent group name, causing 404s and stale member lists that invite duplicate retries; the fetch should key off the immutable id or saved name

[bug] findmembers builds the request url from the live name property, which is two-way bound to the editable name text-field on the admin group form, so paginating or adding members after editing the name (before saving) queries a group name that does not exist. an admin who types a new name and then clicks next/previous or add triggers get /groups/<edited-name>/members.json, which 404s; the member list silently fails to refresh, so addmembers appears to do nothing even though the put succeeded.
